editorialDecisions: The original deck is provenance and inspiration, not automatically an active production contract.
Do not use source-deck stock photography on a public site until rights are verified.
Production team and guest list are tentative/pitch-era roles, not contractual credits.
Any community/Indigenous collaboration must be consent-led and accurately credited.
Only render names and roles that have been checked; AI images are not documentary proof.
No speculative funding outcomes, tax deductions or audience reach claims may be advertised as established facts.
The newer character library is retained intact, with explicit connections and aliases to original-deck guests.
